correspondences.notes: Subset of BIDS dwi volumes; BIDS has no suffix for extracted b0 images.

brainlife.desc: b0 (non-diffusion-weighted) volumes extracted from a DWI, stored in DWI layout; registered as an analysis datatype.
brainlife.name: neuro/dwi/b0

original.readme: We normally store b0 as another neuro/dwi, but this datatype is registered to be "Analysis" datatype which means you can access the data through brainlife's group analysis / jupyter notebook.

brainlife.readme:
We normally store b0 as another neuro/dwi, but this datatype is registered to be "Analysis" datatype which means you can access the data through brainlife's group analysis / jupyter notebook.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.dwi.b0.json

files.desc: b0 volume(s), or their mean, from the DWI (NIfTI).
Gradient directions of the extracted volumes.
b-values of the extracted volumes (zero or near zero).

identifying_risks: JSON metadata may hold acquisition dates, institution or device serials
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level neurodata linkable through a code; no recognisable face at typical resolution.
sharing_cautions: Strip acquisition dates and device identifiers from metadata before sharing
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if metadata keeps acquisition dates or device serials

sources: catalog/apps/<app_id>.json (manifests of the Apps in usage)

inputs_of.name: Apply transformations to T1w
inputs_of.purpose: applies an existing ANTs or FSL transform to a T1-weighted image

intended_use: Reference image for DWI-to-T1w registration and brain masking.
Access to b0 images in group analysis or Jupyter notebooks.
not_suitable_for: Diffusion model fitting; it holds no diffusion-weighted volumes.

outputs_of.name: anatomix-t1w-dwi-registration
outputs_of.purpose: registers a DWI series to a T1-weighted image by aligning its mean b0

outputs_of.name: dwi2b0
outputs_of.purpose: extracts the b0 volumes from a DWI series

outputs_of.name: extract_b0_masks
outputs_of.purpose: extracts each b0 volume from a DWI series and computes brain masks for it

outputs_of.name: test-app-dwi2b0
outputs_of.purpose: test copy of dwi2b0: extracts the b0 volumes from a DWI
